title: Notice of Intent to Single Source to Dataworks Development, Inc.
description: In compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations coupled with the provisions set forth by FAR Subpart 5.101(a)(1), this Notice is hereby published to inform of the following: The U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC), National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS), Office of Management and Budget (OMB) intends to negotiate, on a sole source basis, under authorities provided in the Federal Acquisition Regulations, with Dataworks Development, Inc. The requirement is to procure the following: The Office of Law Enforcement requires the Customer Care Program for Freezerworks Sample Management Software for 6 Ascent Standard Users and 25 Lite Users. This support includes: Free scheduled maintenance releases Free feature-rich software upgrades Discounts on Freezerworks Training Camps and Users Group Meetings Toll-free (U.S.) Technical support by telephone during regular business hours Access to emergency 24-hour support Technical support by email Remote technical support via Online Meeting Membership in the Freezerworks Users Group Self-guided training program for Freezerworks products The supporting rationale is that only one source or brand name is reasonably available as detailed below: The required services must be compatible in all aspects (form, fit, and function) with existing systems or equipment, and the source is uniquely qualified to meet the requirement. The Marine Forensic Laboratory has used Freezerworks software since 2011 for sample management and inventory control purposes. The Freezerworks Customer Care program is needed to maintain the Forensic Laboratory�s continuity of operations. Currently, the Marine Forensic Laboratory uses Freezerworks 2024 Ascent for management of the archive of forensic reference material and related metadata, as well as the evidence samples and case data. The current database contains over 10 years of case/evidence inventory data and an accumulation of data from over 25,000 samples located in the archive. It is extremely important to be able to track where a sample is located as well as keep a record of the data associated with that sample. The laboratory has also integrated case management into Freezerworks, collapsing two databases into one. Use of a single commercially supported software solution will reduce the time and expense invested in IT infrastructure and avoid repeating the mistakes of the past, where staff repeatedly started from scratch in buying and implementing software that was difficult to use and lacked adequate support. It is also critically important to keep the software up to date with bug fixes, security patches, and upgrades, which are included in the Customer Care Package. Without ongoing support, the software will become increasingly out of compliance with NOAA IT security and the hardware and software infrastructure environment in which Freezerworks runs. The source has one or more of the following: an established exclusive licensing agreement, proprietary data, limited rights in data, patent rights, OEM required certifications or OEM authorized reseller, copyrights or secret processes with regard to the supplies or services required. Dataworks Development, Inc. is the only source that offers customer care for Freezerworks software. This particular brand name is essential to the requirement, and market research indicates similar products do not meet or cannot be modified to meet agency needs. The Marine Forensic Laboratory requires the Customer Care for Freezerworks 2024 Ascent from Dataworks Development, Inc., and this developer of this software is the only vendor that provides the customer care and support of this product. Business Impact � Switching to a new software system would also require a contract for customer support from the new vendor. Switching to a new software infrastructure would, in fact, incur additional cost to customize the new database to meet the Forensic Laboratory�s unique needs, transfer the data of 25,000 samples already in inventory, transfer casework data and evidence inventory already in the system, and train personnel on a new system. This would require months of effort and would detrimentally impact the Marine Forensic Laboratory�s mission. The applicable Size Standard is North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 513210 with a Small business size standard of $47M. This Sole Source Determination is based on NOAA's requirement that Dataworks Development, Inc. is the only Vendor that meets the requirements. The period of performance is a one-year base period of performance with four one-year options, periods of performance. **THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS AND NO SOLICITATION PACKAGE IS AVAILABLE. HOWEVER, FIRMS THAT BELIEVE THEY CAN FULLY MEET THE GOVERNMENT'S REQUIREMENTS MAY SUBMIT SUBSTANTIATING DOCUMENTATION IN WRITING TO THE IDENTIFIED POINT OF CONTACT WITHIN 15 DAYS AFTER PUBLICATION OF THIS SYNOPSIS. SUCH DOCUMENTATION WILL BE EVALUATED SOLELY FOR THE PURPOSE OF DETERMINING WHETHER OR NOT TO CONDUCT THIS PROCUREMENT ON A COMPETITIVE BASIS. A DETERMINATION BY THE GOVERNMENT NOT TO CONDUCT A COMPETITIVE PROCUREMENT, BASED UPON RESPONSES TO THIS NOTICE, IS SOLELY WITHIN THE DISCRETION OF THE GOVERNMENT. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS ARE NOT ACCEPTABLE IN RESPONSE TO THIS NOTICE.

title: Repair/Replace Mass Parking Apron Section V at Minot AFB North Dakota
description: Repair/Replace Mass Parking Apron Section V at Minot Air Force Base, Minot, North Dakota. The solicitation will close after 30 days. The solicitation is restricted to Small Businesses. Project Description: This project will be executed using a design-bid-build project delivery method. The entire Mass Parking Apron will be removed and replaced in multiple sections over the course of several years. The existing MPA was originally constructed under two separate contracts. For unknown reasons, the first constructed eastern half is 5 ft narrower than the western half south of the MPA centerline taxiway (335 ft vs 340ft). This project will establish a uniform MPA width of 340 ft south of the MPA centerline taxiway. Due to slight changes in finished top of pavement grades between the new MPA Section(s) pavement and the existing MPA pavement to remain, a new temporary ACC transition will be required to connect new MPA Section(s) PCC pavement to existing MPA PCC pavement. Limited grading of turf areas adjacent to new ACC shoulder pavement to improve surface drainage away from paved shoulder edges (Provide 1-1/2 drop-off at edge per UFC 3-260-01, Chapter 6). Existing asphalt shoulders required to be removed will be milled by the Contractor and stockpiled for Minot AFB use at a later date at the location shown on the drawings. Estimated Construction Costs: The estimated construction cost of this project is between $25,000,000 and $35,000000.

title: HOGEN Generators for the National Logistic Support Center in Grandview, MO
description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration�s (NOAA) Acquisition and Grants Office, Eastern Acquisition Division-Kansas City intends to negotiate and award a purchase order, on a sole source basis, under authority of RFO FAR 6.103-1, with Proton Energy Systems in Wallingford, CT for HOGEN Series 3 Replacement Generators (S10 and S20) to be delivered to the National Logistics Support Center in Grandview, MO. The sole source determination is based on NOAA�s Sole Source Justification. The National Weather Service (NWS), under NOAA, operates and maintains a network of Upper Air (UA) observing stations with some sites that rely on on-site hydrogen generation and storage systems to support routine weather balloon launches. These stations are standardized on the Proton/NEL S20 hydrogen gas generator platform, specifically the Series 2 and Series 3 models, manufactured and distributed exclusively by Proton Energy Systems, Inc., a subsidiary of NEL Hydrogen. This standardization is critical to maintaining consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency across the national network. The Proton/NEL S20 generator has a unique footprint and performance profile that is fully compatible with the physical and functional design of the existing Upper Air Inflation Buildings. It meets the generation requirements necessary to support balloon launches and maintain up to a 350-gallon (200psig) tank of on-site hydrogen storage. These characteristics are not only important from an operational standpoint but also avoid the need for costly modifications to NOAA facilities or significant disruptions to ongoing meteorological operations. Equally important is the software integration associated with these systems. The control software for the generators is embedded directly into the HOGEN units themselves, and support personnel at the Sterling Field Support Center (SFSC) are trained and equipped to interface specifically with this system. If NOAA were to deploy a different hydrogen generation system, SFSC would be unable to provide technical support or troubleshooting assistance, as they do not have access to compatible software platforms for alternative units. This lack of interoperability would represent a significant gap in field support and reduce system availability. Given these factors, including the need for physical and software compatibility, standardized operations, and uninterrupted field support, the Proton/NEL S20 hydrogen generator is the only known product capable of meeting NOAA�s requirements without incurring significant risk or cost. This pre-solicitation notice is not a request for competitive proposals and no solicitation package is available. However, firms that believe they can fully meet the government�s requirements may submit substantiating documentation or a request for additional information in writing to Abigail Green within 15 days after publication of this pre-solicitation notice. Such requests and documentation will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether or not to conduct this procurement on a competitive basis. A determination by the government not to conduct a competitive procurement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the government. Oral communications are not acceptable in response to this pre-solicitation notice.

Technical Capability and Past Performance, when combined, are approximately equal in importance to Price. The Government may select for award the quoter whose price is not necessarily the lowest, but whose technical capability and past performance are sufficiently more advantageous to the Government to warrant the payment of a price premium. Evaluation Factors for Award. Factor 1 � Technical Capability. title: Delta Digital Video Encoder Firmware
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE: AFTC/PZZC, 205 West D Ave, Eglin AFB, Florida 32542, intends to issue a sole-source solicitation directly to Delta Information Systems, Inc., for a Digital Video Encoder Firmware Upgrade. The Government anticipates award in August 2026, of a Firm Fixed Price contract. In accordance with RFO 12.201-1(c) and RFO 5.101(c)(4)(vii), this presolicitation notice is being posted prior to issuing a solicitation directly with the supplier. This notice is NOT a request for competitive proposals, bids, or quotes. A Request for Proposal (RFP) will not be issued. All responsible sources may submit a response in the form of a capability statement which, if received by the response date of this notice, shall be considered by the agency. Submission of such documents shall be at the interested party's expense. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. The 896th Test Support Squadron (896 TSS) at Eglin AFB supports the 96th Test Wing (96TW) through designing, installing, and supporting unique airborne instrumentation to generate decision-quality data in support of Developmental Test and Evaluation. The Delta Digital Video Encoder Model 6008R was selected for the F-16 since it is rugged enough to pass Mil Standards for flight with 8 channels of composite video adherent to IRIG and RCC Standards and interfaces with current aircraft recorder designs. The 896 TSS requires a modification to the Model 6008R firmware to integrate IRIG-106 Chapter 10 User Datagram Protocol(UDP) capability. This will enable the ethernet output to interface seamlessly with the input channel of any compliant IRIG-106 Chapter 10 recorder allowing the system to record the 6008R�s video channels natively in the IRIG-106 Chapter 10 standard format. In accordance with RFO 12.102(a), it has been confirmed there are no other businesses capable of satisfying this requirement for firmware for Delta's encoders. Delta Information Systems (Cage 3T573) is the small business manufacturer of the encoders. The operating firmware required to run and upgrade the 6008R is proprietary to Delta. No other vendor possesses the legal rights, source code access, or proprietary engineering data required to modify the system to natively output the IRIG-106 Chapter 10 standard format. Set-Asides: The proposed contract action will be awarded on a sole source basis. Set-asides are not applicable. NAICS: 334511 PSC: 5821 This acquisition will be awarded on a soles source basis utilizing commercial procedures. This acquisition is not subject to the World Trade Organization Government Procurement Agreement (WTO GPA) and/or a Free Trade Agreement (FTA). Point of contact: Anthony Saporito, Contracting Officer, Anthony.Saporito.1@us.af.mil

title: Repair/Replace Mass Parking Apron Section V at Minot AFB North Dakota
description: Repair/Replace Mass Parking Apron Section V at Minot Air Force Base, Minot, North Dakota. The solicitation will close after 30 days. The solicitation is restricted to Small Businesses. Project Description: This project will be executed using a design-bid-build project delivery method. The entire Mass Parking Apron will be removed and replaced in multiple sections over the course of several years. The existing MPA was originally constructed under two separate contracts. For unknown reasons, the first constructed eastern half is 5 ft narrower than the western half south of the MPA centerline taxiway (335 ft vs 340ft). This project will establish a uniform MPA width of 340 ft south of the MPA centerline taxiway. Due to slight changes in finished top of pavement grades between the new MPA Section(s) pavement and the existing MPA pavement to remain, a new temporary ACC transition will be required to connect new MPA Section(s) PCC pavement to existing MPA PCC pavement. Limited grading of turf areas adjacent to new ACC shoulder pavement to improve surface drainage away from paved shoulder edges (Provide 1-1/2 drop-off at edge per UFC 3-260-01, Chapter 6). Existing asphalt shoulders required to be removed will be milled by the Contractor and stockpiled for Minot AFB use at a later date at the location shown on the drawings. Estimated Construction Costs: The estimated construction cost of this project is between $25,000,000 and $35,000000.

title: 7H--Intent to Sole Source - Treehouse Software Support
description: Department of the Interior (DOI), Interior Business Center (IBC), Acquisition Services Directorate (AQD), Division 1, Branch 1 on behalf of the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO), Enterprise Services Division (ESD), Hosting Services Branch (HSB), hereby announces its intent to award and issue a sole source, Firm-Fixed Price Purchase Order to Treehouse Software Inc. at 2605 Nicholson Rd. Suite: #1230 Sewickley, PA 15143. The software suite is proprietary to Treehouse Software, Inc. and there are no authorized resellers. This is a contract action for the continued need for Treehouse Software licenses and maintenance. The current expiring Order 140D0421P0178 ends on 9/30/2026. The software helps provide critical support to assist in facilitating the management, auditing, and transfer of multiple data elements such as: N2O - Manages Federal Personnel and Payroll System (FPPS) software between Dev/Test and providing auditing information. Auditre - Used for interrogating information on the Mainframe Adaptable Database System (ADABAS) Protection Logs (PLOGS) for auditing and research by personnel. tRelational/DPS - Allows the relation between the ADABAS data needed to be mapped to the Oracle database target. Also used for extracting information via tRrelational from the PLOG's and sending it into Datamart to digest onto the Oracle databases. This procurement will be made utilizing Simplified Acquisition Procedures in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Regulation (FAR) Overhaul 12.201-1 with an anticipated award date by September 29, 2026. The NAICS code is 513210 Software Publishers. Interested vendors that believe they can meet these requirements are encouraged to submit a written notice by providing a capability statement to the primary point of contact. This is not a request for competitive quotations; however, the Government will review any/all product, capabilities, and pricing information submitted prior to the closure of this notice. A determination by the government not to compete this proposed procurement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement.

title: Turner Roof and Building Envelope Project
description: The U.S. General Services Administration intends to solicit construction services for the Turner Roof & Building Envelope Project at the Turner Land Port of Entry, 41725 Turner Road, Turner, Montana 59542, Building No. MT0055AW. The project includes roof replacement and building envelope improvements at the main building, including work on the U.S. and Canadian sides of the facility, and envelope improvements at the water treatment building. Work includes, but is not limited to, selective demolition, roof replacement, exterior wall/cladding repairs, thermal and moisture protection, metals, openings, finishes, and incidental electrical, communications, and security-related coordination. The facility will remain occupied and operational during construction. The contractor must phase and secure the work daily, maintain safe access, protect ongoing border operations, and coordinate with GSA, CBP, CBSA, and other stakeholders regarding antennas, cameras, cables, signs, access, security, and inspections. Work affecting the Canadian side may require Canadian access, work permit, and material import coordination. Certain roofing materials may be furnished through the existing roofing warranty process; the contractor will be responsible for coordinating those materials with the manufacturer/certified installer and providing all remaining labor, materials, equipment, supervision, bonds, permits, and incidentals required to complete the work. The contractor shall comply with the solicitation documents, drawings, specifications, applicable codes and standards, GSA PBS Core Building Standards, security and badging requirements, environmental survey requirements, fire/life safety requirements, submittal requirements, and closeout requirements. The anticipated period of performance is 150 calendar days after notice to proceed. The solicitation is expected to include base bid work for the main building roof and envelope on the U.S. side, main building roof and envelope on the Canadian side, and water treatment building envelope work on the U.S. side. An in-person site visit is anticipated. Currently the date is TBD.
